name: opencontroller
description: OpenController packages for AI-agent virtual controller control, overlays, safety, and replay logs.

scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo examples/*/dist examples/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo .turbo output
scripts.test: bun test packages/core/src/__tests__ packages/cli/src/__tests__ packages/native/src/__tests__ packages/native-linux-uinput/src/__tests__ packages/native-windows-virtual-gamepad/src/__tests__ packages/native-macos-driverkit/src/__tests__ examples/agent-fighter/__tests__
scripts.check:dry-run-examples: bun run examples/basic-dry-run/check.ts && bun run --cwd examples/mcp-controller smoke
scripts.release:check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun audit && bun run pack:check
